description: Use this to find a Chilean company registered with the CMF (the financial regulator) when you do not know its RUT, or to see the whole universe of active securities issuers (about 340: listed companies, bond issuers, pension fund managers, utilities). Pass query with part of the legal name (e.g. 'aguas', 'sonda') or of the RUT; leave it empty to list all. Returns RUT and legal name, with the registry's source_url. Access: open to anonymous agents (rate-limited); a free AndesPass key raises the limit.

query.description: Part of the legal name (e.g. 'aguas') or of the RUT; empty lists every issuer.
query.title: Query
